statement_html:
Compute the area of the parallelogram in the cartesian space whose 4 vertices are
(-7,7,-8) , (-14,-3,-10) , (-10,4,-14) , (-17,-6,-16) .
Enter your reply:
=
hint_html: The area of the parallelogram is the length of the vector product of the two vectors representing two adjacent sides of the parallelogram.
